question: Should bounded batch automation be a permanent public Memory Wiki CLI contract, or should this workflow first be exposed through a narrower plugin/automation seam?
rationale: The patch adds user-facing commands and a versioned manifest format; implementation quality alone cannot establish the intended long-term product boundary.

options.title: Sponsor the CLI contract
options.body: Accept `wiki apply-batch` and `wiki search-batch` as supported automation commands after real behavior and upgrade-boundary proof is added.

options.title: Narrow the extension seam
options.body: Keep the optimization internal or expose a plugin-owned automation API instead of adding new top-level CLI commands.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the CLI contract
recommendation.body: Accept `wiki apply-batch` and `wiki search-batch` as supported automation commands after real behavior and upgrade-boundary proof is added.
